title.zh: FLUX 3 Image上线，先框位置再生图，最高4K、支持10张参考图
title.en: FLUX 3 Image上线，先框位置再生图，最高4K、支持10张参考图

current_state.zh: Black Forest Labs launched FLUX 3 Image, which lets users define element positions with bounding boxes before generation, accepts up to 10 reference images, outputs native 2K/4K, and offers enterprise weights now with open weights due in coming weeks.
current_state.en: Black Forest Labs launched FLUX 3 Image, which lets users define element positions with bounding boxes before generation, accepts up to 10 reference images, outputs native 2K/4K, and offers enterprise weights now with open weights due in coming weeks.
